summary: Female hiker injured her ankle on the Buchanan Pass Trail about 1.25 miles west of the Camp Dick Trailhead; other parties on the trail reported it via ham radio around 1:37 p.m.; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group members hiking in the area were first on scene; she was carried by litter to a 4WD vehicle and then driven to the hospital in a private vehicle; rescue took about 2.5 hours
location: Buchanan Pass Trail, ~1.25 mi west of Camp Dick Trailhead
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Allenspark Fire Protection District
notes: BCSO case #19-5109; official release; date pinned by release (Monday, September 2, 2019)
